usage: agentbreeder events [-h] [--project DIR] [--environment ENVIRONMENT]
                           [--limit LIMIT] [--unread] [--mark-read ID]
                           [--mark-all-read] [--json]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --project DIR         Only this project's events
  --environment ENVIRONMENT
                        Environment for the project's conditions (default:
                        dev)
  --limit LIMIT         Most events to list, 1-500 (default: 50)
  --unread              Only unread events
  --mark-read ID        Mark an event read
  --mark-all-read       Mark every event read (with --project, that project's)
  --json                Print JSON
